\(t=\sqrt3\), so \(A=(3,2\sqrt3)\) and \(N=(0,2\sqrt3)\).  
Since \(AF=\sqrt{2^2+(2\sqrt3)^2}=4\), and \(B\) is \(1\) unit from \(F\) toward \(A\),

\[
B=F+\frac14(A-F)=\left(\frac32,\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right).
\]

Thus

\[
NB=\sqrt{\left(\frac32-0\right)^2+\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}-2\sqrt3\right)^2}
=\sqrt{\frac94+\frac{27}{4}}=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
